modern_index_text: law_names then article_numbers then original chunk text, newline separated
modern_query_tokens: same analyzer, unique nonempty alphanumeric-containing tokens, no expansion
dictionary: Unmodified public jieba resources or CountVectorizer char analyzer (1,1)/(1,2). No application dictionary. Actual library versions and analyzer settings recorded.
candidate_rationale: Character analysis is a mature Chinese lexical baseline avoiding unknown-word segmentation. Fixed adjacent bigrams add local order without scenario vocabulary. This is not a complete reproduction of MTEB preprocessing or stop words.
strata: existing case_type plus explicit title-and-article shape vs scenario; no production parser gold
selection: Rank modern arms by development Hit@5, then MRR@5, then lower second-pass p95. Promotion eligible only if Hit@5 AND MRR@5 meet or exceed legacy-v1 in this same run. This is a development engineering guard, not statistical proof or legal-quality acceptance. If none qualifies, retain negative result and no automatic promotion.
causal_limit: Historical vs modern differs in analyzer, index text and boosts; modern arms share engine/text/score settings and differ in analyzer. One build per arm and fixed order do not establish unbiased production performance.
runtime_scope: direct lexical ranking only; no chat refusal, exact routing, generation, embedding, reranker or checker
limits: 120 reused development cases; 108 retrieval-gold cases, 12 no-gold cases excluded from ranking denominators
Gold not independently legally reviewed; repeated comparison increases selection bias
No claim about Lucene/IK effectiveness without running them
No tuning dictionaries, parameters, gold or protocol after observing this run
Retain the first four-arm negative result unchanged
